final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: diode sinks IREF (10uA)
MB0 ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=8 L=2
* tail current source 20uA
MT  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=16 L=2
* input pair (vinp = non-inverting, on output side)
M1  n1    vinn  tail vss nfet W=40 L=1
M2  x     vinp  tail vss nfet W=40 L=1
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1    n1    vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=0.5
M4  x     n1    vdd vdd pfet W=10 L=0.5
* second stage: PMOS common source, NMOS sink 100uA
M7  vout  x     vdd vdd pfet W=100 L=0.5
M6  vout  ibias vss vss nfet W=80 L=2
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  x     nc    2k
Cc  nc    vout  1p
.ends
